blocks.text: Psalms 14 contains 7 verses. It opens with: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good. It concludes with: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, `and' Israel shall be glad. Psalm 15 A Psalm of David.
